notes: «جَمِيعاً» marks عامر بن عمير and سعيد الأعرج as co-transmitters whose routes meet at Abu Abd Allah: one level, one group
the Imam «أبي عبد الله» comes after «عن» inside the chain, so he is a narrator (owner ruling 2); «(ع)» is left out
«حدثني أبو العباس» is a bare kunya, written as it stands; the words «ائتوا قبر الحسين» are the saying, not a further link
